verdict.rationale: Anrok publishes a hosted API reference at apidocs.anrok.com with per-endpoint descriptions (customers, transactions, address resolution, filings, product mappings) backed by an openapi.yaml spec, plus tutorials with copy-pasteable curl examples. Nothing shows the reference is interactive or that examples run in-browser; the static spec plus curl samples are only a partial delivery. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, in-browser runnable examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
